class.name: YAML
class.brief_description: Converts between YAML text and Godot data structures.

method.name: parse
method.description:
Parses a YAML string into Godot data structures. Returns a [YAMLResult] containing either the parsed data or error information. [codeblock lang=gdscript] var quest_text = """ title: Defeat the Dragon level: 5 rewards: gold: 1000 items: [Dragon Scale, Fire Gem] """
var result = YAML.parse(quest_text) if !result.has_error(): var quest = result.get_data() print("Quest: %s (Level %d)" % [quest.title, quest.level]) else: print("Parse error: %s" % result.get_error()) [/codeblock]

method.name: stringify
method.description:
Converts Godot [param data] to YAML text. Returns a [YAMLResult] containing the generated YAML string or error information. [codeblock lang=gdscript] var spell = { "name": "Fireball", "damage": 45, "mana_cost": 30, "effects": ["Burn", "Light"] }
var result = YAML.stringify(spell) if !result.has_error(): print(result.get_data()) # Output: # name: Fireball # damage: 45 # mana_cost: 30 # effects: # - Burn # - Light [/codeblock]

register_class
unregister_class
method.description:
Unregisters a previously registered custom script class from YAML serialization. [codeblock lang=gdscript] # Unregister the Item class YAML.unregister_class(Item)
# Now Item objects will be serialized as generic dictionaries var sword = Item.new("Iron Sword", 5.0, 100) var result = YAML.stringify(sword) print(result.get_data()) # Output will be a generic dictionary without the !Item tag [/codeblock]

method.name: has_registered_class
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a class with the given name is registered for YAML serialization. [codeblock lang=gdscript] if YAML.has_registered_class("Item"): print("Item class is registered for YAML serialization") else: print("Item class is not registered yet") [/codeblock]

method.name: try_parse
method.description:
Simplified version of [method parse] that returns the parsed data directly, or [code]null[/code] on error. [codeblock lang=gdscript] var data = YAML.try_parse(""" weapon: Axe damage: 25 """)
if data: print("Weapon: %s (Damage: %d)" % [data.weapon, data.damage]) else: print("Failed to parse weapon data") [/codeblock]

create_style
method.description:
Creates a new [YAMLStyle] object for customizing YAML serialization. [codeblock lang=gdscript] var style = YAML.create_style() style.create_child("message").set_string_style(YAMLStyle.STRING_LITERAL) style.create_child("options").set_flow_style(YAMLStyle.FLOW_SINGLE)
var dialog = {"name": "Stranger", "message": "Hello friend!\nCould I interest\nyou in a quest?", "options": ["Yes", "No", "Maybe"]} var result = YAML.stringify(dialog, style) print(result.get_data()) # Output: # name: Stranger # message: | # Hello friend! # Could I interest # you in a quest? # options: ["Yes", "No", "Maybe"]} [/codeblock]

method.name: create_security
method.description:
Creates a new [YAMLSecurity] object for controlling resource loading during YAML parsing. [codeblock lang=gdscript] var security = YAML.create_security()
# Allow only textures from the textures directory security.allow_path("res://textures", ["Texture2D"])
# Parse with custom security settings var result = YAML.parse(yaml_text, security) [/codeblock]

method.name: allow_resource_path
method.description:
Allows resource loading from a specific path prefix for the default security instance. [codeblock lang=gdscript] # Allow loading texture resources from any location in the project YAML.allow_resource_path("res://**", ["Texture2D", "CompressedTexture2D"])
# Now texture references in YAML will load properly var result = YAML.parse(""" player_texture: !Resource 'res://sprites/player.png' enemy_texture: !Resource 'res://sprites/enemy.png' """) [/codeblock]

method.name: block_resource_type
method.description:
Blocks a specific resource type globally for the default security instance. [codeblock lang=gdscript] # Block loading of scenes for security YAML.block_resource_type("PackedScene")
# This YAML will fail to parse if it contains a reference to a scene var result = YAML.parse(""" some_scene: !Resource 'res://scenes/level.tscn' """)
if result.has_error(): print("Error: " + result.get_error_message()) [/codeblock]

method.name: reset_security
method.description:
Resets the default security settings to their original state. [codeblock lang=gdscript] # After making custom security changes, reset to defaults YAML.reset_security()
# Now only the default security settings apply: # - Script and GDExtension resources are blocked # - No path restrictions [/codeblock]

method.name: version
method.description: Returns the version of the YAML GDExtension as a string. [codeblock lang=gdscript] print("Using " + YAML.version()) # Example output: "Using Godot YAML 0.12.1 (release)" [/codeblock]
